ability.name: Team Play
ability.note: This Pokémon deals +20 damage for each friendly [CTRL FID 225][Weavile] on the field.

wheel.name: Taunt
wheel.note: Until the end of your next turn, if the Pokémon hit by this Attack spins a Purple Attack or Blue Attack, shift the result clockwise until a non-Purple, non-Blue attack comes up.

wheel.name: Ice Punch
wheel.note: *If this Pokémon is knocked out, the battle opponent becomes frozen.

wheel.name: Ice Shard
wheel.note: *Opposing Pokémon within 2 steps of this Pokémon spin. If the result is anything other than a Blue Attack, the effects of Sphere plates used on those Pokémon are nullified.
